title: Emergency Board-Up Response Standard, CareLine Service Plans
content:
**Dispatch standard.** Emergency board-up of a broken opening is available on every tier of the CareLine Service Plans family. Each tier sets the surcharge for an emergency board-up visit, which is charged on top of the trip fee, and the number of hours after the call within which the board-up crew arrives.

| Tier | Emergency board-up available | Surcharge on top of the trip fee (USD) | Crew arrives within, after the call |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | Yes | 195.00 | 24 hours |
| CareLine Basic Plan | Yes | 150.00 | 24 hours |
| CareLine Plus Plan | Yes | 125.00 | 12 hours |
| CareLine Premier Plan | Yes | 75.00 | 8 hours |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | Yes | 75.00 | 8 hours |
| CareLine Estate Plan | Yes | 0.00 | 4 hours |

### Reading the arrival standard (hypothetical call times)

| Hypothetical call | Tier | Crew arrives by |
|---|---|---|
| 6:00 p.m. | CareLine Plus Plan | 6:00 a.m. the next morning (12 hours) |
| 6:00 p.m. | CareLine Estate Plan | 10:00 p.m. the same evening (4 hours) |
| 6:00 p.m. | On-Call Service Account | 6:00 p.m. the next day (24 hours) |

### Reading the surcharge

The surcharge is a separate amount from the trip fee: on the CareLine Basic Plan an emergency board-up visit carries the surcharge of 150.00 on top of the trip fee. On the CareLine Estate Plan the surcharge is 0.00.
